mapper.sql: id,conversation_id,sender_id,author_role,client_message_id,ai_run_id,body,CAST(citations AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS citationsText,draft_id,created_at,topic_id,routing_state,context_status,accepted_generation_epoch,trigger_run_id,trigger_job_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM conversations WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM conversations WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE conversations SET active_topic_id=#{topicId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE conversations SET generation_epoch=generation_epoch+1,version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ai_runs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND generation_epoch < #{beforeEpoch} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_runs SET state=#{state},terminal_reason='superseded',finished_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND generation_epoch < #{beforeEpoch} AND state IN('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_INPUT')

UPDATE messages m JOIN ai_runs r ON r.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND r.id=m.context_run_id SET m.context_status='SUPERSEDED' WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND r.state IN('SUPERSEDED','CANCELLED') AND m.author_role='customer'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM messages WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND client_message_id=#{key}
SELECT FROM messages WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM messages WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND id < #{cursor} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE messages SET trigger_run_id=#{runId},trigger_job_id=#{jobId},context_run_id=#{runId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{messageId} AND trigger_run_id IS NULL AND trigger_job_id IS NULL
UPDATE conversations SET last_event_seq=last_event_seq+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE conversation_events SET payload=CAST(#{payload} AS JSON) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND seq=#{seq} AND kind='message.created'
mapper.select: SELECT kind,conversation_id,seq,generation_epoch,CAST(payload AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS payloadText FROM conversation_events WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND seq>#{afterSeq} ORDER BY seq LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE conversations SET status='WAITING_HUMAN',version=version+1,generation_epoch=generation_epoch+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status='AI_ACTIVE'

UPDATE conversations SET status='HUMAN_ACTIVE',assigned_agent_id=#{agentId},version=version+1,generation_epoch=generation_epoch+1,claimed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status='WAITING_HUMAN' AND assigned_agent_id IS NULL AND version=#{version}

UPDATE conversations SET status='CLOSED',version=version+1,generation_epoch=generation_epoch+1,closed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status!='CLOSED'
